[P2] Keep service output independent of the replay snapshot

When a service event lacks Result or Error, these fallbacks populate history from SDK checkpoint observations. `replay.before` uses those same observations, while `replay.after` copies the normalized history. A corrupted checkpoint value can consequently compare equal to itself and pass without independent service evidence. Retrieve missing output independently or mark the comparison incomplete; add a regression with missing service data and a conflicting checkpoint snapshot.
